description: This file contains the implementation of a caching decorator service for catalog view models in an e-commerce web application. It provides cached access to catalogs, brands, and types to improve performance by avoiding redundant data fetches.

classes.name: CachedCatalogViewModelService
classes.description: A service class that wraps CatalogViewModelService with in-memory caching for catalog data, brands, and types.

methods.name: GetCatalogItems
methods.description: Retrieves catalog items, possibly paged and filtered by brand/type, with caching.

methods.name: GetTypes
methods.description: Retrieves list of types with caching.
